description: Run D of the pre-registered simulation matrix (§4b): the same risk sizing as SIM-MATRIX-F with the ALLOCATION caps removed - no stock, sector, portfolio-risk or position-count limit - so that D vs F isolates the caps and A vs D isolates risk-based sizing against a flat 50,000 per trade. The liquidity filters and the participation cap stay identical to F. Research configuration, never activated.
